surfaces.name: codex_custom_session_manager
facts: creates server-owned sessions under a temp root
requires server-issued model id
requires server-issued account selection proof
allows only prompt in prompt dry-run and prompt run payloads
blocks live prompt by default without owner authorization
requires independent WBP trace for full live success

surfaces.name: web_codex_custom_session_routes
facts: checks exact owner authorization phrase at handler construction
routes prompt without authorization to prompt_not_admitted_packet
routes authorized prompt through prompt_packet
forces operator_surface_session.run_prompt with trace_wbp=true

surfaces.name: operator_surface_runner
facts: rejects forbidden browser fields recursively
requires model id from server-issued model list
builds isolated HOME and CODEX_HOME under temp root
uses Codex exec with stdin dash rather than prompt in argv
can enable WBP trace observer
reports current_codex_home_used and temp-root proofs

surfaces.name: wbp_trace_observer
facts: records request and response observation
forwards only admitted OpenAI-compatible paths
does not record prompt body or auth header
does not record raw account or backend ids
